title: Layer Normalization Forward and Backward
signature: def layernorm(x, gamma, beta, dout, eps=1e-5) -> tuple
hints: Layer norm is batch norm turned sideways: the statistics are over the last axis, one mean and variance per row.
gamma and beta are shared by every row, so dgamma and dbeta sum over all leading axes.
With g = dout * gamma: dx = (g - mean(g) - x_hat * mean(g * x_hat)) / sqrt(var + eps), means over the last axis.
